sampleGuidelines.collectionInstruction: Mandatory Requirements: Latest Ultrasound (USG) report with a completely filled Maternal screening TRF form including CRL/BPD, nasal bone status, ductus venosus status, and NT value in millimeters. Please note that this test is not valid for triplets and above.Free beta HCG, PAPPa, AFP, PLGF and NT. Recommended at (gestational age) 11 to 13.6. Trisomy21 & 18/13: Detection rate 97% (3% FPR).
